title: Models generated by indiscernibles
summary: Build models as full Skolem hulls of one indiscernible template and extend increasing maps of the skeletons to specified elementary embeddings.
abstract: A structure generated by a family of points is determined by finite terms in those generators. If every increasing selection of generators has the same complete type, an increasing map of their indices suggests a map of the whole structure: evaluate each term at the corresponding new generators. Making this rule well-defined requires the two structures to share one coherent pattern of types. Making their generated parts elementary requires functions that supply witnesses for every formula, including formulas using previously added functions. These ingredients produce models indexed by any infinite linear order, with elementary maps prescribed by increasing index maps and a precise bound on model size. The distinguished index order need not be recoverable from the original-language model, so this construction alone does not prove that different orders yield nonisomorphic models.
